items.title: How Dick Portillo grew his hot dog empire into an American success story
items.summary: University of Chicago's School of Business economics professor Eric Zwick explains how Dick Portillo grew his empire of a Midwest-based restaurant chain, eventually selling it for nearly $1 billion to private equity in 2014. Zwick co-authored the book "Everywhere Millionaire: Who Is Really Rich in America and How They Got There."
